All payments hereunder shall be payable to IMNTV in United States Dollars on a quarterly basis upon receipt from the wireless carriers in the Territory, except as follows:
findings.explanation: Your payments are conditional upon the client receiving funds from third-party carriers, which ties your payment timing to external events and shifts collection risk onto you.
findings.suggested_change: Payments shall be made to the Contractor on a fixed quarterly basis regardless of third-party collections.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I am reviewing it and have one point to raise before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, the current terms condition payments on third-party collections, which shifts collection risk onto the contractor. We propose modifying this so that payments are made on a fixed quarterly basis regardless of third-party collections. Thank you and best regards,
